# Luxora Glaze System Limited

> Luxora Glaze System Limited is a premium architectural glazing and building-envelope company based in Malindi, Kilifi County, Kenya. It supplies and installs aluminium and uPVC windows and doors, architectural glass, shower enclosures, skylights and garage doors for residential, commercial and hospitality projects across Kenya and East Africa.

Luxora supplies and installs aluminium, uPVC/vinyl and architectural glass systems. It describes itself as a systems partner, not a product supplier: precision engineering, quality materials, expert fabrication, professional installation and after-sales service from one company.

## Products
Aluminium systems: Aluminium Windows, Aluminium Doors, Sliding Doors, Lift & Slide Doors, Folding / Bi-Fold Doors, Pivot Doors.
Vinyl / uPVC systems: uPVC Windows, uPVC Doors, Sliding uPVC Systems, Folding uPVC Doors.
Architectural glass: IGU / Double Glazing, Low-E Glass, Tempered Glass, Laminated Glass, Glass Railings, Skylights.
Specialty products: Frameless Shower Systems, Garage Doors, Custom Glazing Solutions.
Full list: https://www.luxoraglazesystem.com/product-list

## Services
Product selection and specification, supply of systems, site measurement and assessment, professional installation (a 10-step process, with performance requirements confirmed for each project), IGU and safety-glass solutions, large-opening and glazing coordination, technical support, and after-sales and maintenance guidance.

## Frequently asked questions
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Malindi, Mombasa, and the wider Kenyan coast, as well as Nairobi and other regions across Kenya and East Africa for larger commercial and residential projects.

Q: Do you offer free consultations and quotes?
A: Yes, initial consultations and quotes are free. Submit an enquiry through the Contact page, WhatsApp, or call us directly to get started.

Q: What warranty do you offer?
A: Luxora provides after-sales support and warranty coverage on our systems. Applicable warranty terms depend on the selected product, system, and approved project documentation.

Q: How long does installation typically take?
A: Timelines vary by project size and complexity. After an on-site assessment, we'll provide a clear schedule as part of your quote.

Q: Can you work from architectural drawings?
A: Yes, we regularly work directly with architects, engineers, and developers from drawings and specifications for custom and large-scale projects.
